data.note: The task is queued on the durable runtime and runs to completion server-side. Poll `gsk task status sb_task_run::87074314-63ac-4182-9d4e-c67e0ad66fe1::7ab74aeb8912aae4` every 15-60s (simple tasks finish in under a minute; big generations take 5-30 min) until it reports a terminal state — do NOT re-run this submit command; an identical resubmit converges on this same run. Pass `--wait true` only when you deliberately need the legacy blocking call (then set your shell timeout to 1800000 ms). run_id is YOUR internal handle (status/stop); do not show it to the user. task_url is the user-facing task page — hand THAT to the user to click/track; it is not a query API.
